modeling_scope: static architecture-, framework-semantics-, and benchmark-configuration-derived test model; Who&When execution histories are not used for model completion

source.dataset_files: Hand-Crafted/*.json (58 traces retained only as evaluation data, not construction input)
source.architecture_source: Magentic-One technical report and AutoGen architecture documentation

Orchestrator.role: lead agent for task decomposition, planning, delegation, progress tracking, corrective action, and termination

WebSurfer.role: LLM-based web-navigation specialist operating a Chromium-based browser

FileSurfer.role: LLM-based local-file navigation and preview specialist

Coder.role: LLM-based code-writing, analysis, artifact-creation, and debugging specialist

ComputerTerminal.role: execution agent/resource providing console-shell execution for code and commands

agent_coordination.note: The model captures the star-shaped Orchestrator/specialist workflow at the capability level; exact natural-language assignments remain runtime decisions.

agent_tool_bindings.evidence: Magentic-One static architecture: WebSurfer operates a Chromium-based browser
testing abstraction of the markdown-based local-file preview/navigation capability controlled by FileSurfer
Magentic-One static architecture: ComputerTerminal provides console-shell execution

configuration_parameters.budget_policy: The test abstraction decrements the remaining round budget on DELEGATE events. Tool-internal transitions do not consume an additional abstract round.
configuration_parameters.stall_policy: A stall count greater than 2 (represented as 3+) enables REPLAN.

variables.name: executionStatus
variables.role: internal MAS execution lifecycle, distinct from the external test oracle

variables.name: budget
variables.role: remaining abstract round budget; Who&When configures Magentic-One with up to 30 rounds

variables.name: requestSatisfied
variables.role: abstract task-completion judgment maintained by the Orchestrator progress ledger

variables.name: progressStatus
variables.role: abstract forward-progress judgment maintained by the progress ledger

variables.name: loopStatus
variables.role: abstract loop/repetition judgment maintained by the progress ledger

variables.name: stallCount
variables.role: abstract consecutive stall counter; 3+ enables outer-loop replanning

transition_rules.semantics: The Orchestrator receives the task and initializes the outer-loop planning process.

transition_rules.guard: activeEntity == Orchestrator and phase in {Planning, Replanning}
transition_rules.semantics: The Orchestrator creates or revises the task ledger and execution plan.

transition_rules.guard: activeEntity == Orchestrator and phase == Executing and a in {WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder, ComputerTerminal} and budget > 0
transition_rules.semantics: The Orchestrator selects a specialized agent and assigns a subtask.

transition_rules.guard: activeEntity == a and a in {WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder, ComputerTerminal}
transition_rules.semantics: A specialist returns its result or execution observation to the Orchestrator.
Browser control returns to WebSurfer after an observable browser action.
FileSurfer operates the abstract local-file preview/navigation tool entity.
The local-file tool returns control to FileSurfer.
ComputerTerminal executes code or shell commands.
Shell execution returns control to ComputerTerminal.

transition_rules.update: requestSatisfied := True; progressStatus := Forward; loopStatus := NonLooping
transition_rules.semantics: The progress ledger judges the request fully satisfied.

transition_rules.update: requestSatisfied := False; progressStatus := Forward; loopStatus := NonLooping; stallCount := dec_to_zero(stallCount)
transition_rules.semantics: The progress ledger judges that forward progress is being made.

transition_rules.update: requestSatisfied := False; progressStatus := Stalled; stallCount := inc_cap_3plus(stallCount)
transition_rules.semantics: The progress ledger detects lack of forward progress.

transition_rules.update: requestSatisfied := False; loopStatus := Looping; stallCount := inc_cap_3plus(stallCount)
phase := Replanning; progressStatus := Unknown; loopStatus := Unknown; requestSatisfied := Unknown; stallCount := 0
transition_rules.semantics: Stall count exceeding the experimental threshold (>2) triggers the outer-loop reflection and replanning cycle.

transition_rules.update: activeEntity := END; phase := Finalizing; executionStatus := Completed
transition_rules.semantics: The Orchestrator finalizes the task after judging the request satisfied.
The benchmark-level round budget is exhausted.

search_interface.path_representation: finite sequence of enabled transition-rule instances
search_interface.state_space_policy: reachable states are generated on demand; the Cartesian product is never enumerated eagerly

provenance.tools: testing abstraction of capabilities in the static architecture

limitations: Browser, FileSystem, and Shell are testing-level tool entities abstracted from the capabilities operated by WebSurfer, FileSurfer, and ComputerTerminal.
Natural-language Task Ledger and Progress Ledger contents are intentionally not included as state variables.
The model intentionally over-abstracts stochastic LLM decisions into candidate transition outcomes rather than learning behavior from execution traces.
